work_packages.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state
objectives: Acquire and harmonise Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, PlanetScope and ERA5 meteorological data for tomato field state monitoring.
Estimate latent field state (root-zone soil moisture and crop water status) as a calibrated posterior with honest uncertainty via Routes A and B.

tasks.title: Acquire and harmonise multi-sensor EO and meteorological data
Implement Route A direct probabilistic fusion and Route B homogeneous-patch proxy
Calibrate diagnostic branch and produce field state posterior estimates

deliverables.title: Diagnostic model specification and calibration report

work_packages.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration
objectives: Develop uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration with honest parameter posterior and counterfactual irrigation simulation over weather ensembles.
Integrate diagnosis and decision engine into a standalone research demonstrator web MVP at TRL 3-4.

tasks.title: Implement uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration and parameter posterior
Develop counterfactual irrigation simulation and WUE-based decision engine
Build and integrate research demonstrator web MVP

work_packages.title: Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration
objectives: Collect non-destructive physiological ground truth and assess uncertainty calibration against the 90% prediction interval target (RQ5).
Test Route B patch-covariation assumption via co-located seasonal measurement campaign including control-stand variant.

tasks.title: Design and run field validation protocol on Hungarian tomato farms
Assess uncertainty calibration quality against RQ5 target
Run co-located patch-covariation campaign for Route B validation

deliverables.title: Field validation dataset and uncertainty calibration report

work_packages.title: Training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge
objectives: Deliver structured training covering scientific, management and MSCA-PF mandatory transferable-skills dimensions via a jointly prepared Career Development Plan.
Facilitate two-way knowledge transfer: researcher contributes plant-physiology expertise; host transfers geoinformatics and multisensor-fusion methods.

tasks.title: Prepare, submit and periodically review Career Development Plan
Deliver structured transferable-skills training and supervision sessions

work_packages.title: Dissemination, exploitation, communication and management
objectives: Implement open-access dissemination, FAIR data stewardship and demonstrator exploitation throughout the fellowship.
Ensure lightweight project management, coordination and ethics compliance.

tasks.title: Develop and implement open-science dissemination and communication strategy
Manage project coordination, reporting and ethics oversight

edges.derivation: T1-03 produces calibrated field state posterior estimates (RZSM, crop water status); T2-01 implements uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration which requires these field state outputs as driving inputs for crop model parameter inference. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

T3-02 assesses uncertainty calibration quality of the diagnostic branch against the RQ5 90% prediction interval target; it requires the posterior estimates produced by T1-03 to evaluate calibration. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

T3-03 runs the co-located patch-covariation campaign to validate the Route B homogeneous-patch proxy assumption implemented in T1-02; Route B must exist and produce outputs before the campaign can validate it. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

dependency_analysis_notes.source_a_wp_edges: All five work_packages[].dependencies[] arrays are empty in the input artifact (normalization note: 'No dependency arrays present in seed; all WP dependencies set to empty arrays. WP-level dependency edges omitted from dependency_map. Dependency enrichment delegated to wp-dependency-analysis skill.'). Source A contributed 0 WP-level edges.
dependency_analysis_notes.source_b_cross_wp_task_edges: Three cross-WP task edges identified by structural analysis of task titles and WP objectives within the declared input artifact: (1) T1-03→T2-01 (field state posterior consumed by AquaCrop calibration); (2) T1-03→T3-02 (diagnostic branch output assessed for calibration quality); (3) T1-02→T3-03 (Route B implementation validated by patch-covariation campaign).
dependency_analysis_notes.cycle_detection_method: Kahn's topological sort algorithm applied over 18-node, 3-edge directed graph. In-degrees at start: T2-01=1, T3-02=1, T3-03=1; all others=0. All 18 nodes processed to completion; no nodes remained with in-degree>0 after queue exhaustion. No cycles detected.
dependency_analysis_notes.critical_path_method: Longest-path dynamic programming over topological order. Edge weight=1. Maximum path length=1 edge (2 nodes). Three equal-length candidate paths: T1-03→T2-01, T1-03→T3-02, T1-02→T3-03. Critical path reported as T1-03→T2-01 (primary scientific dependency chain: probabilistic diagnostic branch → uncertainty-aware decision engine calibration). All critical_path_nodes verified present in dependency_map.nodes.
dependency_analysis_notes.wp_level_structural_note: WP-level structural dependencies (WP2 depends on WP1 outputs; WP3 validates WP1 outputs) are represented via task-level cross-WP edges per Source B rather than as WP-node edges, because no WP-level dependency declarations exist in the seed's dependencies[] arrays and the task-level edges carry the actual data-flow semantics.
